parsers.supported_input: Combined UTF-8 Markdown with a manifest identifying exact byte ranges, checksums, catalogue IDs and source URLs of Muktabodha source volumes
parsers.output: Source-linked paragraph spans with combined and per-volume byte offsets
parsers.limitations: Function interface only; no full corpus coverage or verse/commentary boundary validation; manifest must account for correct volume selection.

parsers.fail_behavior: Reject invalid or overlapping ranges, checksum mismatches, unsupported publisher headers and empty output.

selection_policy: Profiles are candidates until validated on a specific input; source byte fidelity does not validate scripture boundaries. Do not silently fall back to indexing.
